steps.description: This is the `plugin` array, which takes a package name or a Git URL. A plugin adds behavior: JavaScript or TypeScript that runs at defined moments, such as before a tool call, and can refuse it outright.

The array holds one entry, `git+https://github.com/BillJr99/opencode-auto-models.git`. The page calls this optional, and says it earns its place only once you have a provider whose model list keeps changing, because it merges what the provider reports into your `models` map.

steps.question: The page says the plugin works for any provider built on which adapter package, so an Ollama block and an OpenWebUI block both qualify?

title: The Plugin Array
